intro: Tourism and financial services make the Bahamas one of the richest countries in the Americas per person.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Tourism, including huge cruise ship visits, provides about half of the economy. Offshore banking is the second-biggest industry.

chapters.title: Fishing
text: Spiny lobster is the main fishing export.

keyTerms.meaning: Banking for people from other countries.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Bahamas makes and sells to the world.
